labels.REAL: backed by a deterministic test or live run that was re-run
labels.REAL_RECORDED: author recorded a live run in docs/notes, not re-run here
labels.UNVERIFIED: no artifact, or artifact contradicts the claim
labels.REFUTED: evidence says the claim is false

claims.why: batch.py returns one hard-coded script for every task and decides the tree outcome with `"Welcome" in script`; both runs are identical by construction; every trajectory has host=fixture.
Live Groq run, but all 10 attempted tasks ended not_applied and 20 of 30 were never attempted (prompt over 8K TPM, HTTP 413). It measures harness limits, not model skill.

claims.why: One image in the repo; ADR-005 admits fixture.

claims.claim: Golden-fix CI passes on every push
claims.why: 0 green runs of 7 on GitHub. golden.yml reads a Windows path from config/platform.md and has no pnpm/playwright install. repro.yml fails with ModuleNotFoundError: repro_agent.

claims.claim: Scorer checks the real Canvas UI
claims.why: run-checks.ts builds a synthetic page (a span per selector plus one stylesheet). Checks measure declared CSS, not rendered app behaviour.

claims.claim: 300 mutated tasks are valid and varied
claims.why: 300 dirs exist and passed the validity filter, but all are one CSS property, tier easy, two archetypes, and the ticket text copies the check (selector, property, expected value).

claims.why: Unit-tested on temp fixtures; never run on the real 330 tasks; packages/bench/quarantine/ does not exist.
